settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language for menus and page titles on this device. Applies only to your account at this mandir.

profile.heading: Temple / Mandir Profile
profile.footerPlaceholder: Jai Jinendra! Thank you for your donation.

trustees.heading: Trustees
trustees.helpText: The trustee board of your mandir. Trustees appear in statutory documents and on your temple's public profile.

accounts.heading: Bank & Cash Accounts
accounts.subheading: Accounts used across Cash Book, Bank Book and Ledger.
accounts.useAsDefaultCash: Use as the default cash account
accounts.useAsDefaultBank: Use as the default bank account
accounts.balanceHelp: Opening balance is saved when you click away from the field. It applies to FY {{fy}}.

donorPayments.heading: Direct donations from devotees
donorPayments.acceptRequestsHelp: Devotees on the devotee portal see the details below, pay you directly, and submit the transaction reference + screenshot. You verify and approve each one in <bold>Donation Requests</bold> — only then is the receipt issued.
donorPayments.reg80gYes: 80G registered ({{number}}) — devotees can claim 80G on these donations.
donorPayments.reg80gNo: No 80G registration on Temple Profile — devotees won't be offered 80G on donations here.
donorPayments.upiIdHelp: The devotee app also generates a scannable UPI QR from this ID automatically.
donorPayments.upiQrUrlHelp: If your bank issued a QR poster, host it and paste the image URL — it is shown instead of the generated QR.
donorPayments.bankHeading: Bank account (shown for NEFT / RTGS / IMPS)

receipts.heading: Receipt Settings
receipts.subheading: Design the donation receipts your temple issues. Changes preview live on the right.
receipts.missingWarning: Your <bold>80G registration number</bold> is not set. The 80G receipt template and donor 80G certificates need it. Add it in <bold2>Settings → Temple Profile</bold2>.
receipts.statutoryHelp: These values are managed in <bold>Temple Profile</bold> and are shown here so you can confirm what prints on receipts.
receipts.uploadLogoHelp: PNG, JPG, SVG · max 2 MB · stored as base64
receipts.footerPlaceholder: Jai Jinendra! Thank you for your generous donation.
receipts.sampleDataNote: Sample data shown. Real donor name, amount and receipt number are filled in when a receipt is issued.
receipts.logoRequiredWarn: Logo file must be under 2 MB

accounting.cashBasisDesc: Income & expenses recorded when money actually moves. Simpler; common for temples.
accounting.accrualBasisDesc: Income & expenses recorded when earned/incurred, regardless of payment timing.
accounting.basisHelp: This drives the Income & Expenditure and Balance Sheet. <bold>Cash</bold> counts only money that actually moved; <bold2>Accrual</bold2> recognises income/expenses when earned/incurred and shows unpaid bills (creditors) as liabilities.
accounting.enableDepreciation: Enable depreciation tracking for fixed assets
accounting.depreciationHelp: When on, the Balance Sheet shows fixed assets net of depreciation; when off, at gross cost. Use "Run Depreciation" on the Fixed Assets page to compute & post each year's charge (straight-line or written-down value).

masters.deleteMessage:
Delete "{{name}}"?
Past records that reference it are kept.
masters.noEntries: No entries yet. Click "Add" to create one.
masters.helpText: Configure the dropdown options used across the app. Items are mandir-specific. Deactivating an item hides it from new entries while keeping it on past records.
masters.paymentModesDesc: Shown wherever a payment method is selected.
masters.sevasDesc: Seva options and their default amounts.
masters.gstRatesDesc: GST % applied to taxable services (CGST + SGST for intra-state). Editing a rate here applies it to future Hall, Room and Prasad bookings — Room (Taxable) is used only above the ₹1,000/night threshold. Past records keep their original GST.
masters.hallsDesc: Dharamshala halls available for booking. Tariffs are the default prices — editable per booking.
masters.roomsDesc: Dharamshala rooms available for check-in. Tariff is the default per-night price — editable at checkout.
masters.prasadItemsDesc: Items sold at the Prasad counter (POS). Go to Prasad → Manage Items to adjust stock levels.

gallery.heading: Temple Gallery
gallery.helpText: Photos here appear on your temple's public page in the devotee portal. Paste a public image URL (e.g. from your website or a CDN).

users.heading: User Management
users.subheading: Staff who can log in to this mandir, and their roles. Every mandir always has exactly the Temple Admin role holder in charge — it can only be transferred, never removed.
users.makeTempleAdminTitle: Hand the Temple Admin role to this member
users.transferToStepDown: Transfer the role to step down
users.footerNote: {{admin}} can manage everything. Other roles only see and use the modules that belong to their work — the sidebar adjusts automatically after they log in.

roles.temple_admin: Full access — can void donations, delete data, manage all settings
roles.accountant: Accounts, reports, fixed assets, loans, TDS entries
roles.cashier: Donations, expenses, bookings, prasad, seva, bhojanshala
roles.bhojanshala_cashier: Bhojanshala only — record & redeem meal tokens
roles.priest: View seva bookings, mark them done
roles.viewer: Read-only access to all data (no create/edit)

users.transferMessage:
Transfer the Temple Admin role to {{name}}?

They become the Temple Admin and you keep your other roles (or become Viewer). This takes effect from your next login.

backup.exportHelp: Download a complete JSON backup of this mandir's data — donations, expenses, donors, accounts, bookings and master records. Keep this file safe; it can be used to restore data with help from support.
backup.restoreHelp: To restore data from a backup or an older export file, please contact Tasqbots support. Restores are performed by the support team to protect your existing data.

privacy.syncHelp: When enabled, donations, seva bookings, and room bookings are visible to donors on the JainERP™ devotee portal.
privacy.requirementHelp: Describe any feature, improvement, or customization you need. The Tasqbots team will review and respond.
privacy.requirementPlaceholder: Describe the feature or improvement you need...
